title: Biggest funnel leak
condition: Every funnel step converts at or above its benchmark.
criteria: Every funnel step converts at or above its benchmark.
business_effect: One of view_item→add_to_cart, add_to_cart→begin_checkout, begin_checkout→purchase is below its benchmark; the worst one is named.
action: Fix the page behind the worst funnel step first; the Conversion review below shows what is wrong on it.
doneWhen: That step's rate is within 10% of its benchmark over 14 days in GA4.

title: Product page to add to cart
condition: view_item→add_to_cart at or above 8%.
criteria: view_item→add_to_cart at or above 8%.
business_effect: view_item→add_to_cart below 8% of product viewers.
action: Fix the weakest product page (see GA4-10) using the product-page issues in the Conversion review.
doneWhen: Add-to-cart rate from product views is up over 14 days.

title: Cart to checkout
condition: add_to_cart→begin_checkout at or above 50%.
criteria: add_to_cart→begin_checkout at or above 50%.
business_effect: Fewer than half of the people who add to cart start checkout.
action: Fix the cart issues the Conversion review found (costs, trust, next step) for the people who already chose to buy.
doneWhen: Cart to checkout rate at 50% or more over 14 days.

title: Checkout to purchase
condition: begin_checkout→purchase at or above 50%.
criteria: begin_checkout→purchase at or above 50%.
business_effect: Fewer than half of started checkouts end in a purchase; add_shipping_info / add_payment_info show which sub-step loses them.
action: Run one test order on a phone and check: shipping cost shown before the last step, cash on delivery offered, no forced account, local payment options, no errors.
doneWhen: Each item on that list is tested and fixed or ruled out, and checkout to purchase is at 50% or more.

title: Mobile vs desktop conversion
condition: Mobile conversion is at least 60% of desktop.
criteria: Mobile conversion is at least 60% of desktop.
business_effect: Mobile converts at under 60% of desktop with enough visits on both.
action: Fix the phone issues on the page behind the worst funnel step (Conversion review, phone screenshots).
doneWhen: Mobile conversion at 60% or more of desktop over 14 days.

title: Landing pages with visits but no sales
condition: No high-traffic landing page converts under a third of the store average.
criteria: No high-traffic landing page converts under a third of the store average.
business_effect: A top landing page converts under one third of the store average.
action: Fix that landing page, or stop sending ad traffic to it until it is fixed.
doneWhen: The page converts at half the store average or more, or no paid traffic lands on it.

title: Worst paid campaign and its landing page
condition: No paid campaign with real volume is converting near zero.
criteria: No paid campaign with real volume is converting near zero.
business_effect: A paid campaign brings many visits with almost no sales; named with its landing page.
action: Pause that campaign or point it to a landing page that sells.
doneWhen: The campaign is paused, or its conversion rate is up after the change.

title: Visits with an unknown source
condition: Unassigned and (not set) are under 10% of visits.
criteria: Unassigned and (not set) are under 10% of visits.
business_effect: Over 10% of visits have no known source.
action: Add UTM tags to every ad, bio link, WhatsApp and SMS link.
doneWhen: Unassigned visits under 5% in GA4.

title: Visits from countries you don't sell to
condition: Countries with real traffic also produce sales.
criteria: Countries with real traffic also produce sales.
business_effect: Countries with a real share of visits and zero sales.
action: Exclude those countries from ad targeting.
doneWhen: Paid visits from those countries close to zero.

title: Products viewed but not added to cart
condition: No popular product's add-to-cart rate is far below the store average.
criteria: No popular product's add-to-cart rate is far below the store average.
business_effect: A product page with many views adds to cart at under half the store average.
action: Fix that product page: price, photos, stock, size information. The Conversion review checks this exact product.
doneWhen: That product's add-to-cart rate reaches the store average.

title: Order value vs free-shipping threshold
condition: The free-shipping threshold sits at 1.1–1.6× the average order value.
criteria: The free-shipping threshold sits at 1.1–1.6× the average order value.
business_effect: No threshold found on the site, or it sits below or far above the average order value.
action: Set the free-shipping threshold at about 1.3× your average order value and show it in the cart.
doneWhen: Threshold set at 1.2–1.5× the average order value and visible in the cart.

title: Returning buyers
condition: Returning visitors convert 2× new ones or more, or the site already captures email/WhatsApp.
criteria: Returning visitors convert 2× new ones or more, or the site already captures email/WhatsApp.
business_effect: Returning visitors convert under 2× new ones AND the site has no email/WhatsApp capture.
action: Add an email or WhatsApp signup with a first-order offer, and a message after each purchase.
doneWhen: Signup live on the site and returning-visitor share rising month on month.

title: Site search
condition: Search is visible on phones and tracked.
criteria: Search is visible on phones and tracked.
business_effect: Shoppers search but search is hidden on phones, or search is not tracked so nobody sees what they look for.
action: Make search visible on phones and make sure the top search terms return products.
doneWhen: Search visible on the phone header; the top 5 terms return products.

title: Remarketing audiences
condition: Cart-abandoner or product-viewer audiences exist and Google Ads is linked.
criteria: Cart-abandoner or product-viewer audiences exist and Google Ads is linked.
business_effect: Only default audiences exist, or no Google Ads link to use them in.
action: Create cart-abandoner and product-viewer audiences and share them with Google Ads.
doneWhen: Both audiences exist and show users in Google Ads.

title: Hours and days that convert
condition: Conversion is about even across the day and week.
criteria: Conversion is about even across the day and week.
business_effect: Some hours or weekdays convert far better than others, with enough volume to act on.
action: Schedule ad budget toward the hours and days that convert.
doneWhen: Ad schedule set to match in the ad accounts.

title: Tracking live and stable
condition: Events flowing now, and no unexplained drop week on week.
criteria: Events flowing now, and no unexplained drop week on week.
business_effect: No live users, or visits fell over 40% week on week.
action: Fix the tag before anything else; check the last GTM publish and the last site release.
doneWhen: Events flowing in realtime and no unexplained cliff.

title: Funnel events complete
condition: view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout and purchase all record with plausible counts.
criteria: view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout and purchase all record with plausible counts.
business_effect: A funnel event is missing, or a step is so low (under 30% of benchmark) that the event is likely not firing.
action: Add or fix the missing funnel event so each step can be measured.
doneWhen: Every funnel step shows in GA4 with plausible counts.

title: Purchases and revenue agree
condition: Purchase events, transactions and revenue line up.
criteria: Purchase events, transactions and revenue line up.
business_effect: Purchases and transactions differ by over 10%, revenue is zero, or currency is missing.
action: Fix the purchase tag so each order is sent once with its value and currency.
doneWhen: Purchases equal transactions and revenue matches the store admin within 5%.

title: Payment gateways taking sales credit
condition: No payment gateway shows as a traffic source.
criteria: No payment gateway shows as a traffic source.
business_effect: tabby, tamara, paymob, PayPal, Fawry, a bank or a checkout domain shows as a source.
action: Add those domains to the unwanted referrals list in the GA4 data stream.
doneWhen: They no longer appear as traffic sources.

title: Key events
condition: purchase is a key event and no noise events are.
criteria: purchase is a key event and no noise events are.
business_effect: purchase is not a key event, or page_view/scroll/session_start are.
action: Mark purchase (and lead, if used) as key events and unmark the rest.
doneWhen: Key events list shows only real conversions.

title: Google Ads linked
condition: Google Ads is linked to this property.
criteria: Google Ads is linked to this property.
business_effect: No Google Ads link.
action: Link Google Ads and import purchase so bidding learns from real sales.
doneWhen: purchase shows as a primary conversion in Google Ads.

title: Currency and timezone
condition: Property currency and timezone match the store's market.
criteria: Property currency and timezone match the store's market.
business_effect: Currency or timezone doesn't match the country most visits and sales come from.
action: Set the property currency and timezone to the store's market.
doneWhen: Property settings show the store's currency and timezone.

title: Data kept long enough
condition: Event data retention is 14 months or more.
criteria: Event data retention is 14 months or more.
business_effect: Retention is 2 months.
action: Switch event data retention to 14 months so Ramadan and White Friday can be compared year on year.
doneWhen: Retention setting shows 14 months.

title: Personal data in GA4
condition: No email addresses or phone numbers in page URLs.
criteria: No email addresses or phone numbers in page URLs.
business_effect: Emails or phone numbers appear in page paths sent to GA4.
action: Remove personal data from URLs and turn on email/query redaction in the data stream; Google can delete a property's data for this.
doneWhen: No emails or phone numbers in page paths.

title: Team visits filtered out
condition: An internal-traffic filter is active.
criteria: An internal-traffic filter is active.
business_effect: No internal-traffic rule or filter, so the team's own visits count as shoppers.
action: Define the team's and agency's IP addresses as internal traffic and activate the filter.
doneWhen: The internal-traffic filter shows as active.

title: Each purchase counted once
condition: Purchase tags fire on the dataLayer purchase event and send transaction_id.
criteria: Purchase tags fire on the dataLayer purchase event and send transaction_id.
business_effect: No transaction_id on purchase tags, or purchase fires on a thank-you page view (a refresh counts the order again).
action: Fire purchase tags on the dataLayer purchase event and send transaction_id.
doneWhen: One purchase per order in GA4 and the ad platforms.

title: Purchase sends value, currency and items
condition: Purchase tags send value, currency and items.
criteria: Purchase tags send value, currency and items.
business_effect: Any of value, currency or items missing on a purchase tag.
action: Add value, currency and items to the purchase tags so ads can bid on revenue.
doneWhen: Purchase events carry all three in GA4 DebugView.

title: Meta pixel purchase with deduplication
condition: Meta Purchase event fires with an event_id (for Conversions API deduplication), or Meta isn't used.
criteria: Meta Purchase event fires with an event_id (for Conversions API deduplication), or Meta isn't used.
business_effect: Meta pixel present without a Purchase event, or without event_id.
action: Send the Purchase event to the Meta pixel with an event_id, and set up the Conversions API with the same id.
doneWhen: Meta Events Manager shows deduplicated purchases.

title: Pixels for the channels you pay for
condition: Every paid social channel bringing traffic has its pixel with add-to-cart and purchase.
criteria: Every paid social channel bringing traffic has its pixel with add-to-cart and purchase.
business_effect: TikTok, Snapchat or Meta paid traffic shows in GA4 but that platform's pixel or its ecommerce events are missing.
action: Add the missing platform's pixel with add-to-cart and purchase events.
doneWhen: That platform's events manager shows add-to-cart and purchase.

title: Google Ads conversion tracking
condition: Google Ads conversion tag and Conversion Linker present (or GA4 import used), enhanced conversions on.
criteria: Google Ads conversion tag and Conversion Linker present (or GA4 import used), enhanced conversions on.
business_effect: Ads used but no conversion tag/linker, or enhanced conversions off.
action: Add the Google Ads conversion tag, the Conversion Linker and enhanced conversions.
doneWhen: Google Ads shows the conversion as recording, with enhanced conversions active.

title: Every funnel step has a tag
condition: Tags exist for view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout and purchase.
criteria: Tags exist for view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout and purchase.
business_effect: Any of those events has no tag or trigger.
action: Add tags for the missing funnel events.
doneWhen: Each funnel step shows in GA4.

title: Conversions on events, not page URLs
condition: Conversion tags use dataLayer custom-event triggers.
criteria: Conversion tags use dataLayer custom-event triggers.
business_effect: A conversion tag fires on a page-view trigger matching a thank-you URL.
action: Move conversion tags to custom-event triggers.
doneWhen: No URL-based conversion triggers left.

title: Product data complete
condition: Ecommerce tags send items with item_id, item_name, price and quantity.
criteria: Ecommerce tags send items with item_id, item_name, price and quantity.
business_effect: Items are missing or lack id/price/quantity.
action: Map items with id, name, price and quantity on every ecommerce tag.
doneWhen: GA4's item report shows product names and revenue.

title: No double page views
condition: One Google tag / GA4 config per measurement ID and no extra page_view event tag.
criteria: One Google tag / GA4 config per measurement ID and no extra page_view event tag.
business_effect: Two config tags for the same ID, or a manual page_view on top of the automatic one.
action: Delete the duplicate Google tag or the extra page_view event tag in the container.
doneWhen: One page_view per page load in DebugView.

title: One measurement ID, no stray IDs
condition: Every GA4 tag uses one constant variable with the store's own ID.
criteria: Every GA4 tag uses one constant variable with the store's own ID.
business_effect: Hardcoded or old IDs sending data to another property.
action: Put the ID in one constant variable and remove the others.
doneWhen: Only the store's ID appears in the container.

title: WhatsApp and call clicks tracked
condition: Clicks on WhatsApp and phone links fire an event, or the site has no such links.
criteria: Clicks on WhatsApp and phone links fire an event, or the site has no such links.
business_effect: The site has WhatsApp or tel: links (Browser facts) and no tag tracks them.
action: Track WhatsApp and call clicks as conversions; orders that start in WhatsApp are invisible today.
doneWhen: A whatsapp_click event appears in GA4.

title: Signups and lead forms tracked
condition: Email/phone signups fire sign_up or generate_lead.
criteria: Email/phone signups fire sign_up or generate_lead.
business_effect: The site captures emails or phones and no tag tracks it.
action: Add a sign_up or generate_lead event to the signup forms.
doneWhen: The event appears in GA4.

title: Site search tracked
condition: Searches record a search / view_search_results event with the term.
criteria: Searches record a search / view_search_results event with the term.
business_effect: The site has search and nothing records the term.
action: Track searches with the search term.
doneWhen: Search terms appear in GA4.

title: Ad click IDs kept
condition: gclid, fbclid and ttclid are captured (Conversion Linker, first-party cookies).
criteria: gclid, fbclid and ttclid are captured (Conversion Linker, first-party cookies).
business_effect: Paid traffic arrives with click IDs and nothing stores them.
action: Capture click IDs so sales are credited to the right ad.
doneWhen: Click IDs stored and sent with conversions.

title: Session recordings to prove fixes
condition: Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar is installed.
criteria: Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar is installed.
business_effect: No behaviour-recording tool.
action: Install Microsoft Clarity (free) so every fix in this report can be checked on real recordings.
doneWhen: Recordings visible in Clarity.

title: Consent defaults load first
condition: A consent default fires on Consent Initialization before any tag.
criteria: A consent default fires on Consent Initialization before any tag.
business_effect: Consent default missing or on a later trigger.
action: Move the consent default to the Consent Initialization trigger.
doneWhen: The consent default fires before any other tag.

title: Marketing tags respect a refusal
condition: Marketing tags require ad_storage consent.
criteria: Marketing tags require ad_storage consent.
business_effect: Pixels fire with no consent check.
action: Add consent requirements to every marketing tag.
doneWhen: A visitor who refuses fires no marketing tags.

title: No personal data in tags
condition: No raw email or phone in tag parameters.
criteria: No raw email or phone in tag parameters.
business_effect: Email or phone sent unhashed in a tag.
action: Remove raw email/phone from tags, or hash them where the platform asks for it.
doneWhen: No raw email or phone in any tag.

title: Unknown custom scripts
condition: Every Custom HTML tag has a known purpose and owner.
criteria: Every Custom HTML tag has a known purpose and owner.
business_effect: Custom HTML tags loading scripts from unknown vendors.
action: Remove unknown Custom HTML tags or replace them with gallery templates.
doneWhen: Every Custom HTML tag left in the live version has a named owner and purpose.

title: Old agency and campaign tags
condition: No paused, dead or ex-vendor tags.
criteria: No paused, dead or ex-vendor tags.
business_effect: Paused tags, tags with no trigger, or pixels from past vendors still firing.
action: Delete dead and ex-vendor tags.
doneWhen: None left in the live version.

title: Checkout events on Shopify
condition: Not Shopify, or begin_checkout/purchase come from a Shopify Customer Events pixel or the native integration.
criteria: Not Shopify, or begin_checkout/purchase come from a Shopify Customer Events pixel or the native integration.
business_effect: Shopify store relying on GTM for checkout and purchase (GTM doesn't run inside Shopify checkout).
action: Send checkout and purchase from a Shopify Customer Events custom pixel.
doneWhen: begin_checkout and purchase arrive in GA4 from the custom pixel.

title: Heavy tags on every page
condition: Only core tags fire on All Pages.
criteria: Only core tags fire on All Pages.
business_effect: Heavy third-party tags fire on All Pages though only some pages need them.
action: Scope heavy tags to the pages that need them.
doneWhen: Only the Google tag and consent tags fire on the All Pages trigger.

title: Team visits marked internal
condition: A traffic_type parameter or IP rule marks team visits.
criteria: A traffic_type parameter or IP rule marks team visits.
business_effect: Nothing marks the team's own visits.
action: Add traffic_type for team visits (pairs with GA4-25).
doneWhen: Team visits are tagged internal.

title: Add to cart from the drawer tracked
condition: Our real Add-to-Cart click produced an add_to_cart event (Browser facts), or the tag listens to the theme's AJAX add.
criteria: Our real Add-to-Cart click produced an add_to_cart event (Browser facts), or the tag listens to the theme's AJAX add.
business_effect: Add-to-cart only fires on a form submit or page change, so drawer and quick adds aren't counted.
action: Trigger add_to_cart from the theme's AJAX add-to-cart event.
doneWhen: A drawer add produces add_to_cart in DebugView.

title: Consent not over-blocking GCC visitors
condition: Consent defaults are set per region, or the CMP applies only where required.
criteria: Consent defaults are set per region, or the CMP applies only where required.
business_effect: All tags denied by default for every region, including markets with no such requirement.
action: Set region-specific consent defaults so GCC/Egypt visits record normally.
doneWhen: GCC/Egypt visits record in GA4; EEA visitors stay denied by default.

title: Add to cart works
condition: Our real click added the item and the cart updated.
criteria: Our real click added the item and the cart updated.
business_effect: Clicking Add to Cart did not add the item.
action: Fix the Add-to-Cart button or the theme script behind it.
doneWhen: A click on Add to Cart adds the item and the cart count updates on a phone.

title: Cart and checkout load without errors
condition: No JavaScript errors or failed loads on cart/checkout.
criteria: No JavaScript errors or failed loads on cart/checkout.
business_effect: Errors (including repeating ones) or a failed load on cart or checkout.
action: Fix the errors on the cart and checkout pages.
doneWhen: Zero console errors when cart and checkout load.

title: Broken files on money pages
condition: No 404/500 requests on home, product or cart.
criteria: No 404/500 requests on home, product or cart.
business_effect: Images or scripts failing on those pages.
action: Fix or remove the broken files.
doneWhen: Zero failed requests on home, product and cart.

title: Requests that hang
condition: No request over 3 seconds blocks content.
criteria: No request over 3 seconds blocks content.
business_effect: Requests over 3s delay what the shopper sees.
action: Defer or remove the requests that take over 3 seconds on first load.
doneWhen: No request over 3s on first load.

title: Broken links and the 404 page
condition: Menu and footer links work; the 404 page offers search or a way back.
criteria: Menu and footer links work; the 404 page offers search or a way back.
business_effect: Dead menu/footer links, or a 404 page with no way back.
action: Fix dead links and add search and best-sellers to the 404 page.
doneWhen: No dead menu/footer links; the 404 page has search.

title: Redirect chains
condition: http and non-www reach the final URL in one hop.
criteria: http and non-www reach the final URL in one hop.
business_effect: Two or more redirects before the page.
action: Redirect straight to the final URL in one hop.
doneWhen: http and www versions reach the final URL in 1 redirect.

title: WhatsApp and call links work
condition: WhatsApp/phone links use a full international number, or there are none.
criteria: WhatsApp/phone links use a full international number, or there are none.
business_effect: A wa.me or tel: link with a missing or malformed number.
action: Fix the WhatsApp/phone link to the full international number.
doneWhen: The link opens a chat with the right number.

title: Sold-out products promoted
condition: No sold-out product in the hero or first row of home/collections.
criteria: No sold-out product in the hero or first row of home/collections.
business_effect: Sold-out items featured where shoppers look first.
action: Move sold-out products out of the first row and feature in-stock ones.
doneWhen: No sold-out item in the hero or first row.

title: Main content shows late (LCP)
condition: LCP under 2.5s on the product page (phone).
criteria: LCP under 2.5s on the product page (phone).
business_effect: LCP over 2.5s.
action: Preload the hero/product image and cut render-blocking files.
doneWhen: LCP under 2.5s on a phone.

title: Page jumps while loading (CLS)
condition: CLS under 0.1.
criteria: CLS under 0.1.
business_effect: CLS over 0.1.
action: Set image sizes and reserve space for banners and apps.
doneWhen: CLS under 0.1.

title: Slow to respond to taps
condition: No main-thread task over 200ms on load.
criteria: No main-thread task over 200ms on load.
business_effect: Long tasks make taps lag.
action: Defer heavy scripts until after the page is usable.
doneWhen: No task over 200ms on load.

title: Render-blocking files
condition: No blocking CSS/JS delays first paint.
criteria: No blocking CSS/JS delays first paint.
business_effect: Blocking scripts/styles in the head.
action: Defer or async the blocking files.
doneWhen: No CSS or JS file blocks first paint in a performance trace.

title: Image weight
condition: Images served near display size, in WebP/AVIF, lazy below the fold.
criteria: Images served near display size, in WebP/AVIF, lazy below the fold.
business_effect: Images far bigger than shown, old formats, or below-fold images loading first.
action: Resize images, serve WebP/AVIF and lazy-load below the fold.
doneWhen: No image over 2× its display size.

title: Heavy code on first load
condition: JS + CSS on first load under about 1 MB.
criteria: JS + CSS on first load under about 1 MB.
business_effect: Over budget.
action: Remove unused code and apps.
doneWhen: First-load JS + CSS under budget.

title: Third-party app weight
condition: Chat, review and popup apps load light or late.
criteria: Chat, review and popup apps load light or late.
business_effect: Third-party apps dominate load weight.
action: Drop or delay the heaviest apps.
doneWhen: Third-party JS under budget.

title: Leftover scripts from removed apps
condition: No scripts from apps that no longer do anything.
criteria: No scripts from apps that no longer do anything.
business_effect: Scripts load from app domains with no visible feature (or fail).
action: Remove leftover app code from the theme.
doneWhen: No orphan app scripts load.

title: Heavy hero video on phones
condition: No autoplay video on the phone first screen.
criteria: No autoplay video on the phone first screen.
business_effect: An autoplay video fills the phone first screen.
action: Show a poster image on phones instead of the video.
doneWhen: No autoplay video on the mobile first screen.

title: Compression and caching
condition: Text compressed (gzip/brotli), static files cached long.
criteria: Text compressed (gzip/brotli), static files cached long.
business_effect: Uncompressed text or short cache on static files.
action: Turn on compression and long caching for static files.
doneWhen: HTML, CSS and JS are served with gzip or brotli and static files cache for 30+ days.

title: Arabic font loading
condition: Text visible while web fonts load.
criteria: Text visible while web fonts load.
business_effect: Text invisible until the font loads.
action: Use font-display: swap and a subset Arabic font.
doneWhen: Text visible immediately.

title: Mobile layout
condition: No sideways scroll; tap targets 44px+.
criteria: No sideways scroll; tap targets 44px+.
business_effect: Overflow or small tap targets.
action: Fix the elements that overflow the 390px screen and enlarge tap targets under 44px.
doneWhen: No horizontal scroll; targets 44px or more.

title: Tag on every page type
condition: The tracking tag loads on home, product and cart.
criteria: The tracking tag loads on home, product and cart.
business_effect: Missing on a page type.
action: Install the tag on every page template.
doneWhen: Tag loads on home, product and cart.

title: Add to cart is recorded
condition: Our click produced add_to_cart (dataLayer or GA4 hit).
criteria: Our click produced add_to_cart (dataLayer or GA4 hit).
business_effect: Our Add-to-Cart click produced no add_to_cart event.
action: Send add_to_cart on every add, including the drawer.
doneWhen: add_to_cart appears when Add to Cart is clicked.

title: Event data complete
condition: Ecommerce events carry items, value and currency.
criteria: Ecommerce events carry items, value and currency.
business_effect: Fields missing.
action: Add items, value and currency to the ecommerce events.
doneWhen: All fields present.

title: Tags firing twice
condition: One hit per event.
criteria: One hit per event.
business_effect: Duplicate page_view or events.
action: Remove the duplicate tag or script that sends the same event twice.
doneWhen: Each event sends 1 hit per action in the network log.

title: Ad pixels present
condition: Pixels for the platforms the store advertises on load and fire.
criteria: Pixels for the platforms the store advertises on load and fire.
business_effect: No Meta/TikTok/Snap/Google Ads pixel.
action: Add the pixels for the platforms you advertise on.
doneWhen: Pixels load and fire.

title: Campaign tags survive
condition: UTMs reach the landing page; internal links carry none.
criteria: UTMs reach the landing page; internal links carry none.
business_effect: Redirects strip UTMs, or internal links have UTMs.
action: Keep query strings through redirects and remove UTMs from internal links.
doneWhen: UTMs survive; none on internal links.

title: Old Universal Analytics
condition: No analytics.js / UA- tags.
criteria: No analytics.js / UA- tags.
business_effect: UA code still loads.
action: Remove the old Universal Analytics (analytics.js / UA-) code from the theme.
doneWhen: No UA script loads.

title: dataLayer set before the tag
condition: dataLayer declared before GTM.
criteria: dataLayer declared before GTM.
business_effect: Declared after the container.
action: Declare dataLayer before the GTM snippet.
doneWhen: The page source declares window.dataLayer before the GTM snippet.

title: Consent banner connected
condition: Banner choices change what tags do (Consent Mode signal).
criteria: Banner choices change what tags do (Consent Mode signal).
business_effect: Banner shown, but tags behave the same either way.
action: Connect the banner to Consent Mode.
doneWhen: After a visitor refuses, no marketing tag fires in the network log.

title: Personal data in URLs
condition: No emails/phones in query strings.
criteria: No emails/phones in query strings.
business_effect: Forms put emails or phones in the URL.
action: Send those forms with POST.
doneWhen: No personal data in URLs.

title: HTTPS and checkout trust
condition: Every page and the checkout on HTTPS with no mixed content.
criteria: Every page and the checkout on HTTPS with no mixed content.
business_effect: http reachable, mixed content, or checkout on an unsecured domain.
action: Redirect every http URL to https and replace http resource links in the theme.
doneWhen: Every page and the checkout load on https with zero mixed-content warnings.

title: Security headers and cookies
condition: HSTS, frame protection and secure cookie flags present — or the platform (Shopify, Salla, Zid) manages them.
criteria: HSTS, frame protection and secure cookie flags present — or the platform (Shopify, Salla, Zid) manages them.
business_effect: Missing on a site whose hosting the store controls.
action: Add HSTS, frame-ancestors and Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite flags.
doneWhen: Headers and flags present.

title: Exposed files
condition: No source maps, .env, .git or backups reachable.
criteria: No source maps, .env, .git or backups reachable.
business_effect: Any of them returns 200.
action: Remove or block those files.
doneWhen: All return 404.

title: Vulnerable libraries
condition: No known-vulnerable JS library versions.
criteria: No known-vulnerable JS library versions.
business_effect: An old jQuery or similar with known issues.
action: Update the outdated JavaScript library to its current patched version.
doneWhen: No known-vulnerable versions.

title: Trackers not in the privacy policy
condition: Every third-party tracker is named in the privacy policy.
criteria: Every third-party tracker is named in the privacy policy.
business_effect: Trackers firing that the policy doesn't mention.
action: Remove the tracker or list it in the privacy policy.
doneWhen: The privacy policy names every tracker found on the site.

title: Money pages blocked from Google
condition: Product and collection pages indexable.
criteria: Product and collection pages indexable.
business_effect: noindex/nofollow or robots block on them.
action: Remove the noindex tag or robots.txt rule blocking product and collection pages.
doneWhen: Product and collection pages indexable.

title: Page titles
condition: Unique titles under 60 characters with the product/category name.
criteria: Unique titles under 60 characters with the product/category name.
business_effect: Missing, duplicate or overlong titles.
action: Rewrite titles with the product or category and what it's for.
doneWhen: Unique titles under 60 characters.

title: Descriptions and canonicals
condition: Unique meta descriptions; canonicals point to themselves.
criteria: Unique meta descriptions; canonicals point to themselves.
business_effect: Missing/duplicate descriptions or wrong canonicals.
action: Write unique descriptions and fix the canonicals.
doneWhen: Each page has a unique meta description and a canonical pointing to itself.

title: robots.txt and sitemap
condition: robots.txt valid and lists a reachable sitemap.
criteria: robots.txt valid and lists a reachable sitemap.
business_effect: Missing, blocking, or no sitemap.
action: Fix robots.txt and publish a sitemap.
doneWhen: Sitemap listed and reachable.

title: Product schema
condition: Product pages have Product + Offer with price and availability.
criteria: Product pages have Product + Offer with price and availability.
business_effect: Missing price or availability in schema.
action: Add Product schema with price and availability.
doneWhen: Valid in Google's Rich Results Test.

title: Schema matches the page
condition: Schema price and stock equal what the page shows.
criteria: Schema price and stock equal what the page shows.
business_effect: They differ (Google Shopping disapproves such products).
action: Make the schema use the live price and stock.
doneWhen: Schema price and stock match the visible page in the Rich Results Test.

title: Brand and product IDs in schema
condition: Product schema has brand and GTIN or MPN.
criteria: Product schema has brand and GTIN or MPN.
business_effect: Missing, which limits free Google Shopping listings.
action: Add brand and GTIN/MPN to products.
doneWhen: Fields present in schema.

title: Review stars and breadcrumbs
condition: Reviews and breadcrumbs marked up.
criteria: Reviews and breadcrumbs marked up.
business_effect: Reviews shown but no AggregateRating; no BreadcrumbList.
action: Add review and breadcrumb markup.
doneWhen: Stars eligible in the Rich Results Test.

title: Link previews in WhatsApp and Instagram
condition: og:title, og:image and og:description on home and product.
criteria: og:title, og:image and og:description on home and product.
business_effect: Missing, so shared links show no picture.
action: Add Open Graph title, image and description.
doneWhen: A shared link shows image and title.

title: Arabic and English versions
condition: Correct lang/dir and hreflang; Arabic pages indexable.
criteria: Correct lang/dir and hreflang; Arabic pages indexable.
business_effect: Wrong lang/dir, no hreflang, or Arabic not indexable.
action: Fix lang/dir and add hreflang between the versions.
doneWhen: Both versions indexable with hreflang.

title: Filter and sort pages indexed
condition: Filter/sort URLs are noindex or canonical to the clean collection.
criteria: Filter/sort URLs are noindex or canonical to the clean collection.
business_effect: ?filter / ?sort URLs indexable.
action: Canonical filter/sort URLs to the clean collection.
doneWhen: Only clean collection URLs indexable.

title: Contrast on price and buttons
condition: Price and buy buttons pass WCAG AA contrast.
criteria: Price and buy buttons pass WCAG AA contrast.
business_effect: They fail AA.
action: Darken the price and button colours.
doneWhen: Price and button colours pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 contrast).

title: Product image descriptions
condition: Product images have alt text.
criteria: Product images have alt text.
business_effect: Product images without alt.
action: Add the product name as alt text.
doneWhen: Every product image shows its product name as alt text.

title: Form labels
condition: Every input has a label.
criteria: Every input has a label.
business_effect: Inputs without labels.
action: Add a visible label or aria-label to every form input.
doneWhen: All inputs labelled.

title: Icon buttons named
condition: Cart, menu and search icons have names.
criteria: Cart, menu and search icons have names.
business_effect: Icon buttons with no accessible name.
action: Add aria-labels to the icon buttons.
doneWhen: All icon buttons named.
